Messages.Author: Dave Brereton
Messages.Body:
Question: A Sabbat Gargoyle - !Tremere Slave plays a clan impersonation.
Can he change clans to Camirilla Gargoyle - Tremere Slave? Or does he
change to Camerilla but stay a !Tremere slave? Or if he clan impersonates
another clan entirely does he stay a !Tremere slave?

Question: How does clan impersonation affect Sabbat/Camirilla/Independent?
Could I choose to clan impersonate a Sabbat Assimite with a Camirilla
Gangrel?

Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
In message <B06V7.40550$ip4.8...@news2.calgary.shaw.ca>, Dave Brereton

<Brer...@shaw.ca> writes:
>Question: A Sabbat Gargoyle - !Tremere Slave plays a clan impersonation.
>Can he change clans to Camirilla Gargoyle - Tremere Slave?

No. The Slave effect is only determined by card text.

>Question: How does clan impersonation affect Sabbat/Camirilla/Independent?
>Could I choose to clan impersonate a Sabbat Assimite with a Camirilla
>Gangrel?

You choose the Clan to Clan Impersonate to.

You then take the default sect.

e.g. any vampire doing CI to Assamite will become Independent. (Unless
the Assamite sect-changing vote has been passed.)

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
James Coupe wrote:
>
> In message <B06V7.40550$ip4.8...@news2.calgary.shaw.ca>, Dave Brereton
> <Brer...@shaw.ca> writes:
> >Question: A Sabbat Gargoyle - !Tremere Slave plays a clan impersonation.
> >Can he change clans to Camirilla Gargoyle - Tremere Slave?
>
> No. The Slave effect is only determined by card text.

Correct. He could "impersonate" a Gargoyle, but would remain Sabbat (since
his clan didn't change) and would remain a !Tremere Slave (card text).

> >Question: How does clan impersonation affect Sabbat/Camirilla/Independent?
> >Could I choose to clan impersonate a Sabbat Assimite with a Camirilla
> >Gangrel?
>
> You choose the Clan to Clan Impersonate to.
>
> You then take the default sect.

... *if* you change clans. If you impersonate your current clan, your
sect remains as-is, even if it's not the default sect for your clan.

> e.g. any vampire doing CI to Assamite will become Independent. (Unless
> the Assamite sect-changing vote has been passed.)

Right, except for non-Independent Assamites.
